Package com.kerosene.kfe.audit.adapters.in.reporting

Class KfeDashboardService

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.audit.adapters.in.reporting.KfeDashboardService
@Service public class KfeDashboardService extends Object
Builds the wallet dashboard from persisted wallet aggregates and recent user-visible activity. Live transaction rows take precedence over the expiring statement projection when available.

      public KfeDashboardService(KfeWalletRepository walletRepository, KfeUserStatementRepository statementRepository, KfeTransactionRepository transactionRepository, KfeResponseMapper responseMapper, com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper objectMapper)
      Creates the dashboard service with wallet, ledger, projection, and mapping dependencies.
      Parameters:
      walletRepository - source of user-scoped wallet balance rows
      statementRepository - fallback source of unexpired statement snapshots
      transactionRepository - live participant-visible activity source
      responseMapper - display-safe labels and transaction payload mapper
      objectMapper - JSON codec for statement payloads

  • Method Details

    • dashboard

      @Transactional(readOnly=true) public KfeDashboardResponse dashboard(Long userId)
      Returns user wallets, balance totals, and up to 25 recent activity entries. Spendable totals include available, pending, and locked buckets of spendable wallets; observed-only balances are aggregated separately.
      Parameters:
      userId - owner whose dashboard is requested
      Returns:
      dashboard wallet rows, recent statement, and spendable/observed/combined totals
